incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: service degradation detected for embeddings-usw2. Auto-alert created (INC-17580). Please coordinate customer comms and triage steps. @samira you oncall?

Samira: I'm on. seeing elevated 5xxs from store-config shard. Latency spike ~15:10 UTC. I'll take lead. tagging cs for customer-facing text. @priya can you prep a stub for status page + Zendesk macro?

Priya: Yep. Draft below — please edit and approve. Short public blurb first, then next steps for CS.

Priya: statuspage-bot draft (public):
> We are investigating elevated errors affecting embeddings lookups in the US-WEST-2 region. Some API requests may fail with 5xx or return slower-than-normal responses. Our engineers are actively investigating. We will update within 30 minutes or sooner if there is new information.

Priya: statuspage-bot draft (internal detail for ops):
> Root area: embeddings service -> store-config shard. Initial impact: ~12-18% of embedding requests returning 5xx between 15:05–15:25 UTC. Observed increased CPU on gpu-pool-4 and degraded cache hit rates after a config rollout. Mitigation: rolling rollback of recent store-config change, increasing autoscale target for gpu-pool-4 to reduce queuing.

Ethan: Looks good. Add "customer workaround" line for CS that says to retry with exponential backoff and to prefer a cold start embedding persistence key to avoid repeated cache thrash.

Priya: Got it. Zendesk macro (Agent) - use as reply and paste customer-specific data where <>. Include a short, empathetic opening and actionable steps and a link to status page.

Priya: ```
Macro title: Embeddings partial outage (US-WEST-2)
Macro body:
Hi <Customer first name>,

Thanks for flagging this — we’re sorry for the disruption. We are currently investigating an issue affecting embeddings in the US‑WEST‑2 region which may cause failed or slow requests.

What we're doing:
• Rolling back a recent config change that may be linked to the errors.
• Scaling up GPU capacity in the affected pool to drain queues.

What you can do now:
1) Retry the failing requests after a 1–2s backoff.
2) If you control retry logic, apply exponential backoff (start 500ms, *2, max 8s).
3) If you see repeated failures for the same keys, try a one-time re-ingest of the affected items.

We’ll update here: <status page link> (subscribe for updates).

If you need immediate help, reply to this thread and include your request IDs or account id.
Best,
<agent name> (Support)
```

Devon: For Intercom quick replies, trim down to a 2-sentence version and link back to the Zendesk article.

Devon: Intercom quick reply: "We’re investigating an embeddings issue in US‑WEST‑2 causing intermittent 5xxs. We recommend retrying with exponential backoff; full details & live updates at <status page link>."

Samira: Triage checklist for first responders (paste into incident channel):
1) Confirm alert and amplify if >5% error rate for >5m.
2) Attach relevant logs: `ingest-embeddings`, `store-config`, `gpu-pool-4` from the 15m window.
3) Check recent deploys: `git log --since='1 hour' --pretty=oneline` for store-config service.
4) If a config rollout is implicated, trigger rollback with: `kubectl apply -f rollout-vX-previous.yaml` and watch pod restarts.
5) Increase autoscale temporarily: `redwood infra scale gpu-pool-4 --min 2 --max 12` (ops only).
6) Monitor error rate and latency in Grafana -> Embeddings Overview dashboard.
7) If mitigation reduces errors, prepare stabilized status update: cause/mitigation/eta.

Priya: Agent checklist for customer replies (short):
• Acknowledge within 10 min.
• Use Zendesk macro above; fill placeholders.
• Ask for request IDs if customer reports repeated errors.
• Offer to route to Escalations if they are in a live production incident with impacted SLAs.

Samira: Posting to status page now. Priya, please create the Zendesk macro and publish the Intercom quick reply. Once posted, reply here with macro ID and Intercom snippet so agents can use.

CS Ops Bot: Macro created: `zendesk_macros/embeddings_usw2_partial_outage_v1`
Intercom quick reply created: `intercom_quick_replies/embeddings_usw2_short_v1`

Priya: Great — pinned both in the Knowledgebase. Also adding canned escalation text for account managers: "We are actively mitigating; we've rolled back the recent config change and scaled capacity. Expected restoration within 15–30 minutes; we'll follow up if ETA changes."

Ethan: On-call handoff note to include when shifting:
> HANDOFF - current state: rollback started at 15:18 UTC; error rate down from 18% to 6% after first batch. Next steps: finish rollback, monitor CPU on gpu-pool-4, verify no regression on correctness tests. If re-increase >10%, escalate to SRE second pager.

Samira: Leaving a quick runbook for next shift:
- Key dashboards: Embeddings Overview, GPU Utilization, Store-config deploys.
- Important logs: `store-config/error.log`, `embedding/cache.log`.
- Contact chain: @ethan (SRE lead), @devon (infra), @priya (CS lead).

Devon: Small note for agents: If a customer is on Dedicated plan, add: "We can offer to move your requests to a cross-region failover (us-east-1) if you want immediate resilience; open a support ticket to initiate."

Samira: Update 15:40 UTC — rollback finished. Error rate down to ~1.5%. Posting final update to status page and closing incident in 30m after stable metrics.

statuspage-bot: Public update posted: "Mitigation in progress — we've rolled back the change causing elevated errors and scaled capacity. Most customers should see normal behavior; we continue to monitor."

CS Ops Bot: Suggested internal closure message for agents to paste into threads when closing:```
We’re closing this ticket related to the partial embeddings outage in US‑WEST‑2. The root cause was a recent config rollout that reduced cache effectiveness, which we rolled back. If you continue to see issues, reply and include request IDs.
```

Samira: Thanks team. If anything flares, please reopen the thread and ping @oncall. Leaving handoff note pinned.

Ethan: :thumbsup: nice work all — capture the postmortem notes and we'll schedule a quick blameless RCA tomorrow.

Priya: I'll draft the customer follow-up email with timelines and postmortem excerpt.

incident-bot: Incident INC-17580 transitioned to "resolved" at 15:59 UTC.
